title: DraftApproveResponse
description:
A recorded approval. A second press of the same version answers the first one, with
`created: false`.

bundle_hash.description: The hash of the whole bundle approved: the plan, its design note, its ADRs (§D3).

created.description: False when this press found an approval of the same version already recorded.

self_approved.description: The person approved their own agent's plan: allowed, and said (ADR 0054).
